summary: Part 1 of 3 (00:00 to 02:20) of the '12.0 South Africa Bulk Shipments (Seller & KAMs)' training. Revibe's Dubai-to-South Africa route changes so that all of a seller's South Africa orders for the day go in one box that Quiqup (spelled QuickUp in the narration) collects once a day, instead of one DHL label per order. The trainer walks through the four daily steps: Ready for pickup in the Orders page of the Revibe seller panel, a barcode on every device printed from the Consolidation Panel, one big box sealed with red tape (shown on a slide only), and Mark ready for collection to hand over to Quiqup. Steps 1, 2 and 4 are done in the seller panel; step 3 is physical. Covers the Orders page, the Consolidation Panel (Open box tab, Print all barcodes, Barcode, Mark ready for collection, Remove), device barcode placement and handling rules. All 40 listed frames were opened. Part 2 of the video is not covered here.
